remarks: Boutique Luxury Condo "The Classic" 25 Forest. A 24/7 Concierge Upscale High Rise In The Heart Of Downtown Stamford. A Spacious Styling Gem! Located Near Stamford Restaurants, Town Center, Pickel Ball, Train- Metro North, Theaters And more.
